aboutFocus.tagline: welcome to my corner of the web.
aboutFocus.paragraph1: I'm Anush, a UI Architect and Frontend Engineer with 7+ years turning messy product requirements into interfaces people actually enjoy using. Most of that time has been spent deep in React and TypeScript, building production UIs for iGaming, E-commerce, Admin tooling, and Edtech platforms.
aboutFocus.paragraph2: I'm fluent in the tools that make good UI work: Next.js/React.js for the app layer, Tailwind for styling, Storybook for component docs, Figma for handoff, plus a real focus on accessibility, testing, and design-system consistency. Lately I've been leaning into AI-assisted workflows to move faster without cutting corners.
aboutFocus.paragraph3: When I'm not shipping components, I'm usually refining my own tooling or exploring whatever's new in the frontend world.
